title: gluerun Rehydrate Authored-Knowledge Manifest
description: Additive contract for the config-gated authored-knowledge manifest emitted by gluerun_ctx_rehydrate_authored_manifest and recorded under the core manifest's optional `authored` key. Records which human-curated authored entries were injected, at which content hashes. Every entry is pinned class=authored-knowledge and authoritative=false so the schema can never certify an authored entry as authoritative.
